grammar.explanation: 随着 introduces a process or developing situation; connect it to an actual change rather than merely listing unrelated facts.

examples.zh: 随着相邻内容改变，同一句带出的意思也变了。
examples.py: suí zhe xiāng lín nèi róng gǎi biàn , tóng yī jù dài chū de yì si yě biàn le .
examples.en: As neighbouring wording changes, the same line’s implications change too.

examples.zh: 随着声音变轻，我更注意他的动作。
examples.py: suí zhe shēng yīn biàn qīng , wǒ gèng zhù yì tā de dòng zuò .
examples.en: As the sound grows softer, I attend more to his actions.

commonMistakes.wrong: 随着声音变轻，所以它一直没有任何变化。
commonMistakes.right: 随着声音变轻，我更注意他的动作。
commonMistakes.why: The first clause names the developing change.

grammar.explanation: These deny certainty, not necessarily the proposition itself. Show the clue and keep the remaining alternatives open.

examples.zh: 收好信不一定是不想再见。
examples.py: shōu hǎo xìn bù yí dìng shì bù xiǎng zài jiàn .
examples.en: Putting letters away does not necessarily mean refusing another meeting.

examples.py: yǒu xī wàng wèi bì jiù bù nán guò .
examples.en: Hope does not necessarily remove sadness.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不一定再见，所以一定永远不见。
commonMistakes.right: 收好信不一定是不想再见。
commonMistakes.why: Uncertainty about reunion is not certainty of permanent separation.

grammar.explanation: 把…当成… states what someone treats something as. It does not automatically make that classification correct.

examples.zh: 我把关盒子当成关灯了。
examples.py: wǒ bǎ guān hé zi dàng chéng guān dēng le .
examples.en: I mistook closing the box for switching off the light.

examples.zh: 别把人物的经历当成表演者的经历。
examples.py: bié bǎ rén wù de jīng lì dàng chéng biǎo yǎn zhě de jīng lì .
examples.en: Don’t treat the character’s experience as the performer’s.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我把它当成事实，所以它一定是事实。
commonMistakes.right: 我把关盒子当成关灯了。
commonMistakes.why: The construction can describe a mistaken interpretation.

grammar.explanation: The paired clauses can express compatible perspectives or goals. A second feeling does not have to cancel the first.

examples.zh: 这里既有难过，也有一点希望。
examples.py: zhè lǐ jì yǒu nán guò , yě yǒu yī diǎn xī wàng .
examples.en: There is both sadness and some hope here.

examples.zh: 我既想听明白，也想说清自己的看法。
examples.py: wǒ jì xiǎng tīng míng bái , yě xiǎng shuō qīng zì jǐ de kàn fǎ .
examples.en: I want both to understand and explain my view.

commonMistakes.wrong: 既有希望，就一定没有难过。
commonMistakes.right: 这里既有难过，也有一点希望。
commonMistakes.why: The paired construction explicitly allows coexistence.

grammar.explanation: Give a comparison basis and an observed difference. A difference between two versions does not identify every viewer’s response.

examples.zh: 跟短版相比，完整版多了开窗的动作。
examples.py: gēn duǎn bǎn xiāng bǐ , wán zhěng bǎn duō le kāi chuāng de dòng zuò .
examples.en: Compared with the short version, the full version adds the window action.

examples.zh: 跟第一遍相比，这次我听清了收信。
examples.py: gēn dì yī biàn xiāng bǐ , zhè cì wǒ tīng qīng le shōu xìn .
examples.en: Compared with the first viewing, I heard putting letters away clearly this time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 跟短版相比，所有人一定有完全相同的感受。
commonMistakes.right: 跟短版相比，完整版多了开窗的动作。
commonMistakes.why: Compare observable content before predicting other people’s feelings.

lines.zh: 你觉得最后把信收起来，是不想再见那个人了吗？
lines.py: nǐ jué de zuì hòu bǎ xìn shōu qǐ lái , shì bù xiǎng zài jiàn nà gè rén le ma ?
lines.en: Does putting the letters away mean never wanting to see that person again?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我觉得是暂时不再一直看，不一定是不想再见。
lines.py: wǒ jué de shì zàn shí bù zài yì zhí kàn , bù yí dìng shì bù xiǎng zài jiàn .
lines.en: I think it means no longer constantly reading them, not necessarily refusing another meeting.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 可他把盒子关上了。
lines.py: kě tā bǎ hé zi guān shang le .
lines.en: But he closed the box.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 后来又打开窗，灯还留着，你怎么看这一点？
lines.py: hòu lái yòu dǎ kāi chuāng , dēng hái liú zhe , nǐ zěn me kàn zhè yī diǎn ?
lines.en: Then he opened the window and left the light on. How do you read that?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 像是在等，不过没有说谁会来。
lines.py: xiàng shì zài děng , bù guò méi yǒu shuō shéi huì lái .
lines.en: Like waiting, but it doesn’t say who will come.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，这也是我不想直接说永远不见的原因。
lines.py: duì , zhè yě shì wǒ bù xiǎng zhí jiē shuō yǒng yuǎn bú jiàn de yuán yīn .
lines.en: Right. That’s why I don’t want to claim never meeting again.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 前半段那句我听成把灯关了。
lines.py: qián bàn duàn nà jù wǒ tīng chéng bǎ dēng guān le .
lines.en: I heard the earlier line as turning the light off.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是把信收了，不是把灯关了。
lines.py: shì bǎ xìn shōu le , bù shì bǎ dēng guān le .
lines.en: Putting letters away, not turning the light off.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 难怪我以为后面又开灯，前后不太对。
lines.py: nán guài wǒ yǐ wéi hòu miàn yòu kāi dēng , qián hòu bù tài duì .
lines.en: No wonder I thought the light came back on and the sequence didn’t fit.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 完整视频里，灯一直亮着，只有盒子关上。
lines.py: wán zhěng shì pín lǐ , dēng yì zhí liàng zhe , zhǐ yǒu hé zi guān shang .
lines.en: In the full video the light stays on; only the box closes.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 朋友发我的短版，没有最后开窗那一下。
lines.py: péng you fā wǒ de duǎn bǎn , méi yǒu zuì hòu kāi chuāng nà yī xià .
lines.en: My friend’s short version omitted the final window-opening action.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那你少看了一个能影响理解的动作。
lines.py: nà nǐ shǎo kàn le yī gè néng yǐng xiǎng lǐ jiě de dòng zuò .
lines.en: Then you missed an action that could affect the interpretation.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我还是觉得最后有点难过。
lines.py: wǒ hái shi jué de zuì hòu yǒu diǎn nán guò .
lines.en: I still find the ending a little sad.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我也觉得，没有说有希望就一定不难过。
lines.py: wǒ yě jué de , méi yǒu shuō yǒu xī wàng jiù yí dìng bù nán guò .
lines.en: Me too. Some hope doesn’t necessarily remove sadness.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你会在推荐里写什么？
lines.py: nǐ huì zài tuī jiàn lǐ xiě shén me ?
lines.en: What would you write in a recommendation?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先看完整的，注意灯、盒子和窗，再说自己的看法。
lines.py: xiān kàn wán zhěng de , zhù yì dēng , hé zi hé chuāng , zài shuō zì jǐ de kàn fǎ .
lines.en: Watch the full version; notice the light, box and window, then give your view.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不能直接写大家都会被感动吧？
lines.py: bù néng zhí jiē xiě dà jiā dū huì bèi gǎn dòng ba ?
lines.en: We can’t simply write that everyone will be moved, can we?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，我可以写自己被哪一点打动，不替所有人答应。
lines.py: duì , wǒ kě yǐ xiě zì jǐ bèi nǎ yī diǎn dǎ dòng , bù tì suǒ yǒu rén dā yìng .
lines.en: Right. I can say which detail moved me, without speaking for everyone.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 周末的小型表演有朗读，也有一段新写的短歌。节目先讲一个人整理旧信的情形，再由他自己唱。桌上放着盒子，旁边有灯，窗在更远一点的地方。开头他一直看信，唱到把旧信收进盒里，才把纸慢慢放好。灯没有关，只是他的目光从纸上移开，让观众看到他不再只注意手里那一点过去。
lines.py: zhōu mò de xiǎo xíng biǎo yǎn yǒu lǎng dú , yě yǒu yī duàn xīn xiě de duǎn gē . jié mù xiān jiǎng yī gè rén zhěng lǐ jiù xìn de qíng xíng , zài yóu tā zì jǐ chàng . zhuō shàng fàng zhe hé zi , páng biān yǒu dēng , chuāng zài gèng yuǎn yī diǎn de dì fāng . kāi tóu tā yì zhí kàn xìn , chàng dào bǎ jiù xìn shōu jìn hé lǐ , cái bǎ zhǐ màn màn fàng hǎo . dēng méi yǒu guān , zhǐ shì tā de mù guāng cóng zhǐ shàng yí kāi , ràng guān zhòng kàn dào tā bù zài zhǐ zhù yì shǒu lǐ nà yī diǎn guò qù .
lines.en: A small weekend performance combined reading and an original song. A person sorted old letters before singing. A box sat on a table, a light beside it and a window farther away. He put the papers away when singing that line, leaving the light on and shifting his gaze from the letters.

lines.zh: 我最初听到收信，就以为人物准备完全断开以前的联系。但是下一句唱不是把名字忘记，后面又说灯仍旧留在窗边，这使我的判断停了一下。收好东西可以是改变每天看它的习惯，也可以是想重新安排今天，不一定等于把过去都否定。我没有因此确定他一定会和谁见面，只是发现永远不见的说法也缺乏足够支持。
lines.py: wǒ zuì chū tīng dào shōu xìn , jiù yǐ wéi rén wù zhǔn bèi wán quán duàn kāi yǐ qián de lián xì . dàn shì xià yī jù chàng bù shì bǎ míng zi wàng jì , hòu miàn yòu shuō dēng réng jiù liú zài chuāng biān , zhè shǐ wǒ de pàn duàn tíng le yī xià . shōu hǎo dōng xi kě yǐ shì gǎi biàn měi tiān kàn tā de xí guàn , yě kě yǐ shì xiǎng chóng xīn ān pái jīn tiān , bù yí dìng děng yú bǎ guò qù dōu fǒu dìng . wǒ méi yǒu yīn cǐ què dìng tā yí dìng huì hé shéi jiàn miàn , zhǐ shì fā xiàn yǒng yuǎn bú jiàn de shuō fǎ yě quē fá zú gòu zhī chí .
lines.en: I first took putting letters away as breaking all contact. “Not forgetting the name” and the light remaining qualified that judgment. Changing a daily habit or making room for today needn’t reject the past. That doesn’t guarantee reunion, but weakens the claim of never meeting again.

lines.zh: 短歌重复了两次把旧信收进盒里。第一次后面连着不是把名字忘记，第二次后面接给今天留一点空。同样一句，随着相邻的内容不同，提醒我看的地方也不同：一处解释没有做什么，一处说接下来想给什么留位置。重复不是只为了让观众记住几个字，也让听者把前后的变化放在一起。
lines.py: duǎn gē chóng fù le liǎng cì bǎ jiù xìn shōu jìn hé lǐ . dì yī cì hòu miàn lián zhe bù shì bǎ míng zi wàng jì , dì èr cì hòu miàn jiē gěi jīn tiān liú yī diǎn kōng . tóng yàng yī jù , suí zhe xiāng lín de nèi róng bù tóng , tí xǐng wǒ kàn de dì fāng yě bù tóng : yī chù jiě shì méi yǒu zuò shén me , yī chù shuō jiē xià lái xiǎng gěi shén me liú wèi zhì . chóng fù bù shì zhǐ wèi le ràng guān zhòng jì zhù jǐ gè zì , yě ràng tīng zhě bǎ qián hòu de biàn huà fàng zài yì qǐ .
lines.en: The repeated box line first leads to not forgetting, later to space for today. Nearby wording changes its focus: what the action does not mean and what it makes room for. Repetition connects a shift, not merely memorisation of words.

lines.zh: 最后唱如果风带来消息，我会把窗再打开。歌停以后，人物没有站在原地等一个确定的人上场，而是自己走向窗，把窗打开一点，又回头收好桌上的笔。这个动作展现愿意接触外面的可能，也保留他继续做自己事情的部分。现场没有别人回来，没有一句话保证未来，所以我不把那个开窗解释成已经团圆。
lines.py: zuì hòu chàng rú guǒ fēng dài lái xiāo xī , wǒ huì bǎ chuāng zài dǎ kāi . gē tíng yǐ hòu , rén wù méi yǒu zhàn zài yuán dì děng yī gè què dìng de rén shàng chǎng , ér shì zì jǐ zǒu xiàng chuāng , bǎ chuāng dǎ kāi yī diǎn , yòu huí tóu shōu hǎo zhuō shàng de bǐ . zhè gè dòng zuò zhǎn xiàn yuàn yì jiē chù wài miàn de kě néng , yě bǎo liú tā jì xù zuò zì jǐ shì qíng de bù fèn . xiàn chǎng méi yǒu bié ren huí lái , méi yǒu yī jù huà bǎo zhèng wèi lái , suǒ yǐ wǒ bù bǎ nà gè kāi chuāng jiě shì chéng yǐ jīng tuán yuán .
lines.en: The final conditional news and window line is followed by opening the window slightly and returning to tidy a pen. No other person enters. Openness to possibilities coexists with ordinary ongoing activity; the action does not establish reunion.

lines.zh: 音乐开始时，旁边的人弹得轻，后面有一小段停顿，能听见盒子关上的一声。这样的安排让我注意动作，不是每一秒都由声音填满。有朋友说那里像没准备好，我请他回看盒子关上的时候；他听见那个声音以后，觉得可能是特意留的。不过我们也没有看到全部准备过程，讨论的是作品里可以注意到的效果。
lines.py: yīn yuè kāi shǐ shí , páng biān de rén tán de qīng , hòu miàn yǒu yī xiǎo duàn tíng dùn , néng tīng jiàn hé zi guān shang de yī shēng . zhè yàng de ān pái ràng wǒ zhù yì dòng zuò , bù shì měi yī miǎo dōu yóu shēng yīn tián mǎn . yǒu péng you shuō nà lǐ xiàng méi zhǔn bèi hǎo , wǒ qǐng tā huí kàn hé zi guān shang de shí hou ; tā tīng jiàn nà gè shēng yīn yǐ hòu , jué de kě néng shì tè yì liú de . bù guò wǒ men yě méi yǒu kàn dào quán bù zhǔn bèi guò chéng , tǎo lùn de shì zuò pǐn lǐ kě yǐ zhù yì dào de xiào guǒ .
lines.en: Quiet accompaniment pauses for the box’s closing sound, directing attention to action. A friend initially heard the pause as unpreparedness; seeing its timing suggested an intentional effect. We discussed observable effect without claiming access to all preparation.

lines.zh: 我看过完整视频，也收到一个只拍上半身的短版。短版在最后一句以后马上结束，没有人物走向窗的动作。只听这版，确实更容易把结尾想成一直留在过去。朋友的理解不是凭空来的，而是他得到的内容较少。后来我们一起看完整的，他没有立刻变得和我一样，只说开窗让愿意往前走的解释多了一点依据。
lines.py: wǒ kàn guò wán zhěng shì pín , yě shōu dào yī gè zhǐ pāi shàng bàn shēn de duǎn bǎn . duǎn bǎn zài zuì hòu yī jù yǐ hòu mǎ shàng jié shù , méi yǒu rén wù zǒu xiàng chuāng de dòng zuò . zhǐ tīng zhè bǎn , què shí gèng róng yì bǎ jié wěi xiǎng chéng yì zhí liú zài guò qù . péng you de lǐ jiě bù shì píng kōng lái de , ér shì tā dé dào de nèi róng jiào shǎo . hòu lái wǒ men yì qǐ kàn wán zhěng de , tā méi yǒu lì kè biàn de hé wǒ yī yàng , zhǐ shuō kāi chuāng ràng yuàn yì wǎng qián zǒu de jiě shì duō le yī diǎn yī jù .
lines.en: The upper-body short video ends before the window action. It plausibly invites a more backward-looking reading because it provides less evidence. Watching the full version didn’t make my friend identical in opinion; it added support for moving forward.

lines.zh: 我还是觉得这段有难过的地方：信收起来以前停了一下，唱你不必现在回来时声音很轻。我也看到一点希望：灯留着，窗后来打开，最后一句不是我永远等着，而是我也会走向明天。这些感觉可以同时存在，不必把整个表演只选成高兴或伤心。解释作品的深度，不是把感受说得越来越大，而是能让别人找到你注意的那一处。
lines.py: wǒ hái shi jué de zhè duàn yǒu nán guò de dì fāng : xìn shōu qǐ lái yǐ qián tíng le yī xià , chàng nǐ bù bì xiàn zài huí lái shí shēng yīn hěn qīng . wǒ yě kàn dào yī diǎn xī wàng : dēng liú zhe , chuāng hòu lái dǎ kāi , zuì hòu yī jù bù shì wǒ yǒng yuǎn děng zhe , ér shì wǒ yě huì zǒu xiàng míng tiān . zhè xiē gǎn jué kě yǐ tóng shí cún zài , bù bì bǎ zhěng gè biǎo yǎn zhǐ xuǎn chéng gāo xìng huò shāng xīn . jiě shì zuò pǐn de shēn dù , bù shì bǎ gǎn shòu shuō de yuè lái yuè dà , ér shì néng ràng bié ren zhǎo dào nǐ zhù yì de nà yī chù .
lines.en: Hesitation over the letters and the quiet return line feel sad; the retained light, opened window and moving-towards-tomorrow line suggest hope. Both can coexist. A useful interpretation points others to particular details rather than merely intensifying emotional labels.

lines.zh: 推荐给另一位朋友时，我说可以先看完整的，再比较不同版本，不要只因为一句被单独拿出来，就认为知道全部情节。我写了自己喜欢的重复手法，也说最后仍然有不确定的地方。至于唱的人自己经历过什么，我不知道，也没有拿人物的一封信替他写生活。这是一段值得讨论的表演，不需要先发明表演者的过去，才让自己的感受显得认真。
lines.py: tuī jiàn gěi lìng yī wèi péng you shí , wǒ shuō kě yǐ xiān kàn wán zhěng de , zài bǐ jiào bù tóng bǎn běn , bú yào zhǐ yīn wèi yī jù bèi dān dú ná chū lái , jiù rèn wéi zhī dào quán bù qíng jié . wǒ xiě le zì jǐ xǐ huān de chóng fù shǒu fǎ , yě shuō zuì hòu réng rán yǒu bù què dìng de dì fāng . zhì yú chàng de rén zì jǐ jīng lì guò shén me , wǒ bù zhī dào , yě méi yǒu ná rén wù de yī fēng xìn tì tā xiě shēng huó . zhè shì yī duàn zhí de tǎo lùn de biǎo yǎn , bù xū yào xiān fā míng biǎo yǎn zhě de guò qù , cái ràng zì jǐ de gǎn shòu xiǎn de rèn zhēn .
lines.en: My recommendation suggests the complete version and comparison, describes the repetition I liked and preserves uncertainty. The performer’s personal history is unknown; a character’s letter cannot supply it. Discussion doesn’t need invented biography to make an interpretation meaningful.

choices: Specific evidence, version differences and honest uncertainty
A promise that every viewer will be moved
A biography invented from the lyric
questions.answer: Specific evidence, version differences and honest uncertainty

questions.q: What happens after the window is opened a little?
choices: The character returns to tidy a pen
Another character returns and promises marriage
The light is switched off for the first time
questions.answer: The character returns to tidy a pen

questions.q: What does the last action not establish?
choices: That a reunion has already happened
That the window is opened
That the character also continues ordinary activity
questions.answer: That a reunion has already happened

A guarantee that someone has already returned

extraReadings.title: Discuss the details that moved you: words in context
extraReadings.titleZh: 把感受说具体 · 词语练习
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Retrieve these words in separate everyday situations.

lines.zh: 情节里先收好旧信，后来才走向窗边。
lines.py: qíng jié lǐ xiān shōu hǎo jiù xìn , hòu lái cái zǒu xiàng chuāng biān .
lines.en: The plot first has the old letters put away, then a move towards the window.

lines.zh: 这个情节前面出现过一次。
lines.py: zhè gè qíng jié qián miàn chū xiàn guò yī cì .
lines.en: This event appeared once earlier in the story.

lines.zh: 剧本只写打开窗，没有写是谁回来。
lines.py: jù běn zhǐ xiě dǎ kāi chuāng , méi yǒu xiě shì shéi huí lái .
lines.en: The script says to open the window, not who returns.

lines.zh: 他改了剧本的最后两句。
lines.py: tā gǎi le jù běn de zuì hòu liǎng jù .
lines.en: He changed the last two lines of the script.

lines.zh: 这段诗歌把灯和等待放在一起。
lines.py: zhè duàn shī gē bǎ dēng hé děng dài fàng zài yì qǐ .
lines.en: This poem connects a light with waiting.

lines.zh: 她喜欢先朗读诗歌，再讲自己的理解。
lines.py: tā xǐ huān xiān lǎng dú shī gē , zài jiǎng zì jǐ de lǐ jiě .
lines.en: She likes reading poetry aloud before explaining her interpretation.

lines.zh: 重复同一句是一种手法，不是忘了换词。
lines.py: chóng fù tóng yī jù shì yī zhǒng shǒu fǎ , bù shì wàng le huàn cí .
lines.en: Repeating the same line is a device, not forgetting to change words.

lines.zh: 这幅画用不同手法表现远处和近处。
lines.py: zhè fú huà yòng bù tóng shǒu fǎ biǎo xiàn yuǎn chù hé jìn chù .
lines.en: The painting uses different techniques for distant and nearby areas.

lines.zh: 窗边的灯让我联想到有人等着。
lines.py: chuāng biān de dēng ràng wǒ lián xiǎng dào yǒu rén děng zhe .
lines.en: The light at the window makes me think of someone waiting.

lines.zh: 听到这段声音，她联想到小时候的家。
lines.py: tīng dào zhè duàn shēng yīn , tā lián xiǎng dào xiǎo shí hòu de jiā .
lines.en: This sound brought her childhood home to mind.

lines.zh: 最后他的目光从盒子移到窗外。
lines.py: zuì hòu tā de mù guāng cóng hé zi yí dào chuāng wài .
lines.en: Finally his gaze shifts from the box to outside the window.

lines.zh: 她的目光一直停在那幅画上。
lines.py: tā de mù guāng yì zhí tíng zài nà fú huà shàng .
lines.en: Her gaze remained on the painting.

lines.zh: 他的神情放松了一点，没有立刻笑。
lines.py: tā de shén qíng fàng sōng le yī diǎn , méi yǒu lì kè xiào .
lines.en: His expression relaxed a little without an immediate smile.

lines.zh: 她看信时的神情，和刚才不同。
lines.py: tā kàn xìn shí de shén qíng , hé gāng cái bù tóng .
lines.en: Her expression reading the letter differed from before.

lines.zh: 这个频道放了完整表演，不只有一小段。
lines.py: zhè gè pín dào fàng le wán zhěng biǎo yǎn , bù zhǐ yǒu yī xiǎo duàn .
lines.en: This channel posted the full performance, not just a short extract.

lines.zh: 她换了频道，想找刚才的节目。
lines.py: tā huàn le pín dào , xiǎng zhǎo gāng cái de jié mù .
lines.en: She changed channels to find the earlier programme.

lines.zh: 我先看完整视频，再比较朋友发来的短版。
lines.py: wǒ xiān kàn wán zhěng shì pín , zài bǐ jiào péng you fā lái de duǎn bǎn .
lines.en: I watch the full video before comparing the short version from a friend.

lines.zh: 视频里听不清最后一句。
lines.py: shì pín lǐ tīng bù qīng zuì hòu yī jù .
lines.en: The final sentence is unclear in the video.

lines.zh: 这段拍摄只对着上半身，没拍到窗边的动作。
lines.py: zhè duàn pāi shè zhǐ duì zhe shàng bàn shēn , méi pāi dào chuāng biān de dòng zuò .
lines.en: This recording frames only the upper body, missing the action at the window.

lines.zh: 他们明天下午拍摄，不是今天晚上。
lines.py: tā men míng tiān xià wǔ pāi shè , bù shì jīn tiān wǎn shang .
lines.en: They will shoot tomorrow afternoon, not this evening.

lines.zh: 摄影师问，最后要不要把窗也放进画面。
lines.py: shè yǐng shī wèn , zuì hòu yào bù yào bǎ chuāng yě fàng jìn huà miàn .
lines.en: The camera operator asked whether to include the window in the final frame.

lines.zh: 她请摄影师晚一点再拍合照。
lines.py: tā qǐng shè yǐng shī wǎn yī diǎn zài pāi hé zhào .
lines.en: She asked the photographer to take the group photo later.

lines.zh: 先朗读两句，看看停在哪里。
lines.py: xiān lǎng dú liǎng jù , kàn kàn tíng zài nǎ lǐ .
lines.en: Read two lines aloud first and consider where to pause.

lines.zh: 他朗读的时候，没有把标点读成词。
lines.py: tā lǎng dú de shí hou , méi yǒu bǎ biāo diǎn dú chéng cí .
lines.en: While reading aloud he didn’t pronounce punctuation as words.

lines.zh: 他一开始弹得轻，后来慢慢响起来。
lines.py: tā yī kāi shǐ tán de qīng , hòu lái màn màn xiǎng qǐ lái .
lines.en: He plays quietly at first, then gradually louder.

lines.zh: 她今天想弹一段，不想唱整首。
lines.py: tā jīn tiān xiǎng tán yī duàn , bù xiǎng chàng zhěng shǒu .
lines.en: Today she wants to play a passage, not sing the whole piece.

lines.zh: 琴放在窗边，不在门口。
lines.py: qín fàng zài chuāng biān , bù zài mén kǒu .
lines.en: The instrument is beside the window, not the door.

lines.zh: 这把琴是借来的，结束以后要归还。
lines.py: zhè bǎ qín shì jiè lái de , jié shù yǐ hòu yào guī huán .
lines.en: This instrument is borrowed and must be returned afterwards.

lines.zh: 我听见一声响，才注意到盒子关了。
lines.py: wǒ tīng jiàn yī shēng xiǎng , cái zhù yì dào hé zi guān le .
lines.en: I heard a sound and noticed the box had closed.

lines.zh: 她喊了两声，门口的人才听见。
lines.py: tā hǎn le liǎng shēng , mén kǒu de rén cái tīng jiàn .
lines.en: She called twice before the person at the entrance heard.

lines.zh: 只听录音和看现场，是不同的情形。
lines.py: zhǐ tīng lù yīn hé kàn xiàn chǎng , shì bù tóng de qíng xíng .
lines.en: Hearing a recording and seeing it live are different circumstances.

lines.zh: 这种情形以前发生过，但结果不一样。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng qíng xíng yǐ qián fā shēng guò , dàn jié guǒ bù yī yàng .
lines.en: This situation occurred before, with a different result.

lines.zh: 收好信以后，那个人仍旧记得过去。
lines.py: shōu hǎo xìn yǐ hòu , nà gè rén réng jiù jì de guò qù .
lines.en: After putting the letters away, the person still remembers the past.

lines.zh: 下雨了，活动仍旧在室内进行。
lines.py: xià yǔ le , huó dòng réng jiù zài shì nèi jìn xíng .
lines.en: It is raining, but the event still takes place indoors.

lines.zh: 这里的灯如同一个还没说出的邀请。
lines.py: zhè lǐ de dēng rú tóng yī gè hái méi shuō chū de yāo qǐng .
lines.en: The light here resembles an invitation not yet spoken.

lines.zh: 这段回忆如同一张慢慢展开的地图。
lines.py: zhè duàn huí yì rú tóng yī zhāng màn màn zhǎn kāi de dì tú .
lines.en: This memory resembles a map gradually unfolding.

lines.zh: 讲清细节，比只说有深度更能解释我的看法。
lines.py: jiǎng qīng xì jié , bǐ zhǐ shuō yǒu shēn dù gèng néng jiě shì wǒ de kàn fǎ .
lines.en: Explaining details conveys my view better than merely saying it has depth.

lines.zh: 我们后来讨论的深度，比第一次大。
lines.py: wǒ men hòu lái tǎo lùn de shēn dù , bǐ dì yī cì dà .
lines.en: Our later discussion went deeper than the first.

lines.zh: 旧信让他想起一起住过的时光。
lines.py: jiù xìn ràng tā xiǎng qǐ yì qǐ zhù guò de shí guāng .
lines.en: The old letters remind him of their time living together.

lines.zh: 她把那段时光记在日记里。
lines.py: tā bǎ nà duàn shí guāng jì zài rì jì lǐ .
lines.en: She recorded that period in her diary.

lines.zh: 岁月过去，信上的字还在。
lines.py: suì yuè guò qù , xìn shàng de zì hái zài .
lines.en: Years pass, but the writing on the letters remains.

lines.zh: 这张照片留下了那段岁月的样子。
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān liú xià le nà duàn suì yuè de yàng zi .
lines.en: This photo preserves how that period looked.

lines.zh: 我说的是剧里的人物，不知道表演者自己的经历。
lines.py: wǒ shuō de shì jù lǐ de rén wù , bù zhī dào biǎo yǎn zhě zì jǐ de jīng lì .
lines.en: I mean the character; I don’t know the performer’s own experience.

lines.zh: 两个读者对这个人物看法不同。
lines.py: liǎng gè dú zhě duì zhè gè rén wù kàn fǎ bù tóng .
lines.en: Two readers view this character differently.

lines.zh: 节目先朗读一段散文，再唱这几句。
lines.py: jié mù xiān lǎng dú yī duàn sǎn wén , zài chàng zhè jǐ jù .
lines.en: The programme reads a prose passage aloud before singing these lines.

lines.zh: 这篇散文没有完整故事，写的是一个下午。
lines.py: zhè piān sǎn wén méi yǒu wán zhěng gù shì , xiě de shì yī gè xià wǔ .
lines.en: This prose piece describes an afternoon rather than a full plot.

lines.zh: 最后的动作展现了一点变化，没有把未来说死。
lines.py: zuì hòu de dòng zuò zhǎn xiàn le yī diǎn biàn huà , méi yǒu bǎ wèi lái shuō sǐ .
lines.en: The final action shows some change without fixing the future.

lines.zh: 她用一个例子展现两种做法的差别。
lines.py: tā yòng yī gè lì zi zhǎn xiàn liǎng zhǒng zuò fǎ de chā bié .
lines.en: She used an example to show the difference between two approaches.

extraReadings.title: The shorter version I received
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 朋友给我发来一个短视频，说这段表演很有意思。我在回家的车上看，声音不大，有几个字没听清。画面只拍到一个人的上半身，手里拿着信，后来把信放下。我看见他的神情，没有看见桌子的全貌，也不知道灯是不是从头就亮着。看完以后，我发了一句，感觉他一直在等以前的人回来。
lines.py: péng you gěi wǒ fā lái yī gè duǎn shì pín , shuō zhè duàn biǎo yǎn hěn yǒu yì si . wǒ zài huí jiā de chē shàng kàn , shēng yīn bù dà , yǒu jǐ gè zì méi tīng qīng . huà miàn zhǐ pāi dào yī gè rén de shàng bàn shēn , shǒu lǐ ná zhe xìn , hòu lái bǎ xìn fàng xià . wǒ kàn jiàn tā de shén qíng , méi yǒu kàn jiàn zhuō zi de quán mào , yě bù zhī dào dēng shì bú shì cóng tóu jiù liàng zhe . kàn wán yǐ hòu , wǒ fā le yī jù , gǎn jué tā yì zhí zài děng yǐ qián de rén huí lái .
lines.en: A friend’s short video reached me on the journey home. Quiet audio obscured words; an upper-body frame showed letters and expression, not the whole table or the light’s earlier state. I replied that the character seemed to wait for someone from the past.

lines.zh: 朋友问我最后开窗怎么看。我才知道自己的版本没有这个动作，在最后一句唱完就停了。她没有直接说我看错，而是把完整频道里的视频发来，让我看看前后。回家后我重新看，发现灯始终没关，关的是装信的盒子。原来我听成关灯，也把收信和关灯合成了一件事，难怪觉得没有留下任何联系。
lines.py: péng you wèn wǒ zuì hòu kāi chuāng zěn me kàn . wǒ cái zhī dào zì jǐ de bǎn běn méi yǒu zhè gè dòng zuò , zài zuì hòu yī jù chàng wán jiù tíng le . tā méi yǒu zhí jiē shuō wǒ kàn cuò , ér shì bǎ wán zhěng pín dào lǐ de shì pín fā lái , ràng wǒ kàn kàn qián hòu . huí jiā hòu wǒ chóng xīn kàn , fā xiàn dēng shǐ zhōng méi guān , guān de shì zhuāng xìn de hé zi . yuán lái wǒ tīng chéng guān dēng , yě bǎ shōu xìn hé guān dēng hé chéng le yī jiàn shì , nán guài jué de méi yǒu liú xià rèn hé lián xì .
lines.en: Asked about opening the window, I realised my version ended earlier. The full channel video showed that the light stayed on and the letter box closed. A misheard light action had compounded my interpretation of putting letters away as complete disconnection.

lines.zh: 我先把歌词朗读了一遍，不跟音乐，听清楚把旧信收进盒里后面还有不是把名字忘记。我指给朋友看，说刚才车上真把收信听成了关灯。她把视频往前拖了一点，桌上的灯一直亮着。我又读了一遍，想到的是把东西放好以后，仍然舍不得走；她说自己倒是先注意到后面开窗。我们把两个地方都找出来，轮流看了一次。
lines.py: wǒ xiān bǎ gē cí lǎng dú le yī biàn , bù gēn yīn yuè , tīng qīng chǔ bǎ jiù xìn shōu jìn hé lǐ hòu miàn hái yǒu bù shì bǎ míng zi wàng jì . wǒ zhǐ gěi péng you kàn , shuō gāng cái chē shàng zhēn bǎ shōu xìn tīng chéng le guān dēng . tā bǎ shì pín wǎng qián tuō le yī diǎn , zhuō shàng de dēng yì zhí liàng zhe . wǒ yòu dú le yī biàn , xiǎng dào de shì bǎ dōng xi fàng hǎo yǐ hòu , réng rán shě bu de zǒu ; tā shuō zì jǐ dǎo shì xiān zhù yì dào hòu miàn kāi chuāng . wǒ men bǎ liǎng gè dì fāng dōu zhǎo chū lái , lún liú kàn le yī cì .
lines.en: I read the lyrics without music and caught the line after putting the old letters in a box: it wasn't forgetting the name. On the bus I'd really heard putting away letters as turning off the light. My friend dragged the video back—the lamp stayed on. I still felt the character was reluctant to leave after tidying. She'd noticed the later window opening first. We found both moments and watched them in turn.

lines.zh: 完整画面里，歌结束以后，他走向窗，又回头收桌上的笔。我想了一会儿，说这不是只等别人行动，也在做自己的事。朋友认为这是愿意往前走，我觉得更像还在试着往前走。我们没有争谁已经猜到作者最后决定，而是各自指出走到窗边和回头这两处动作，讨论哪一处更影响自己的判断。
lines.py: wán zhěng huà miàn lǐ , gē jié shù yǐ hòu , tā zǒu xiàng chuāng , yòu huí tóu shōu zhuō shàng de bǐ . wǒ xiǎng le yī huì er , shuō zhè bù shì zhǐ děng bié ren xíng dòng , yě zài zuò zì jǐ de shì . péng you rèn wéi zhè shì yuàn yì wǎng qián zǒu , wǒ jué de gèng xiàng hái zài shì zhe wǎng qián zǒu . wǒ men méi yǒu zhēng shéi yǐ jīng cāi dào zuò zhě zuì hòu jué dìng , ér shì gè zì zhǐ chū zǒu dào chuāng biān hé huí tóu zhè liǎng chù dòng zuò , tǎo lùn nǎ yī chù gèng yǐng xiǎng zì jǐ de pàn duàn .
lines.en: Opening the window and then tidying the pen suggested action beyond waiting. My friend saw moving forward; I saw trying to move forward. We discussed the visible actions instead of competing to know an author’s final private decision.

lines.zh: 关于停顿，我第一遍以为弹琴的人忘了下一段。后来我听到停的时候正好有盒子关上的声音，觉得留空可能是一种手法。我没有因此说每一个停顿都一定特别设计，也没有说所有不流畅都等于有深度。这一次能找到声音和动作的联系，就先说这一处，不必把一个新的解释扩大到所有表演。
lines.py: guān yú tíng dùn , wǒ dì yī biàn yǐ wéi tán qín de rén wàng le xià yī duàn . hòu lái wǒ tīng dào tíng de shí hou zhèng hǎo yǒu hé zi guān shang de shēng yīn , jué de liú kōng kě néng shì yī zhǒng shǒu fǎ . wǒ méi yǒu yīn cǐ shuō měi yī gè tíng dùn dōu yí dìng tè bié shè jì , yě méi yǒu shuō suǒ yǒu bù liú chàng dōu děng yú yǒu shēn dù . zhè yī cì néng zhǎo dào shēng yīn hé dòng zuò de lián xì , jiù xiān shuō zhè yī chù , bù bì bǎ yī gè xīn de jiě shì kuò dà dào suǒ yǒu biǎo yǎn .
lines.en: I first thought the accompanist forgot the next passage. The timed box sound suggested a device, without establishing that every pause is deliberate or every awkwardness profound. One observable connection supports a local interpretation, not a universal rule.

lines.zh: 还有人留言说，唱得这么难过，表演者肯定经历过同样的事。我没有接着猜。故事里有信和等待，能说明人物的处境；唱的人可能在表演，也可能有自己的联想，我们并没有问过他。想讨论他的表达，可以说哪一句轻、哪里停、神情怎么变，不必先替他写一个确定的生活经历，再把作品里的每个字放进去。
lines.py: hái yǒu rén liú yán shuō , chàng de zhè me nán guò , biǎo yǎn zhě kěn dìng jīng lì guò tóng yàng de shì . wǒ méi yǒu jiē zhe cāi . gù shì lǐ yǒu xìn hé děng dài , néng shuō míng rén wù de chǔ jìng ; chàng de rén kě néng zài biǎo yǎn , yě kě néng yǒu zì jǐ de lián xiǎng , wǒ men bìng méi yǒu wèn guò tā . xiǎng tǎo lùn tā de biǎo dá , kě yǐ shuō nǎ yī jù qīng , nǎ lǐ tíng , shén qíng zěn me biàn , bù bì xiān tì tā xiě yī gè què dìng de shēng huó jīng lì , zài bǎ zuò pǐn lǐ de měi gè zì fàng jìn qù .
lines.en: A comment inferred the performer must have lived the same sadness. I didn’t join the speculation. Letters and waiting establish the character’s situation, not the performer’s unasked history. Vocal and visual details permit discussion without a fabricated biography.

lines.zh: 第二天我和朋友一边散步一边聊，没有把所有句子都说成很大的评价。她说灯留着像一个没说出的邀请，我说收信以后还回头，也像还舍不得。两种联想都能在画面里找到一点依据，但也都不是画面直接告诉我们的结论。后来我们各自再想了一句，如果没有最后开窗，我们会怎么理解，这让讨论比只重复很好更具体。
lines.py: dì èr tiān wǒ hé péng you yī biān sàn bù yī biān liáo , méi yǒu bǎ suǒ yǒu jù zi dōu shuō chéng hěn dà de píng jià . tā shuō dēng liú zhe xiàng yī gè méi shuō chū de yāo qǐng , wǒ shuō shōu xìn yǐ hòu hái huí tóu , yě xiàng hái shě bu de . liǎng zhǒng lián xiǎng dōu néng zài huà miàn lǐ zhǎo dào yī diǎn yī jù , dàn yě dōu bù shì huà miàn zhí jiē gào sù wǒ men de jié lùn . hòu lái wǒ men gè zì zài xiǎng le yī jù , rú guǒ méi yǒu zuì hòu kāi chuāng , wǒ men huì zěn me lǐ jiě , zhè ràng tǎo lùn bǐ zhǐ chóng fù hěn hǎo gèng jù tǐ .
lines.en: On a walk we compared the retained light as invitation and the backward glance as attachment. Both have some support without being explicitly announced conclusions. Considering how omission of the window would change the reading made discussion more concrete than repeated praise.

lines.zh: 我把完整视频发给另一位朋友，说看完再告诉我最喜欢哪一段。她晚上回我，先说那个开窗的动作，又问我为什么一直在讲灯。我把刚才漏听的两句发过去，她说原来收的是信，不是把灯关掉。第二天见面，我们又把短版打开，对着时间找少掉的那几秒。她喜欢后半段的声音，我更注意角色回头的地方，两个人各把自己喜欢的那一段放了一遍。最后她把歌名存好，说下次坐车也要听，我提醒她别学我把一句话听成另一句。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ wán zhěng shì pín fā gěi lìng yī wèi péng you , shuō kàn wán zài gào sù wǒ zuì xǐ huān nǎ yī duàn . tā wǎn shang huí wǒ , xiān shuō nà gè kāi chuāng de dòng zuò , yòu wèn wǒ wèi shén me yì zhí zài jiǎng dēng . wǒ bǎ gāng cái lòu tīng de liǎng jù fā guò qù , tā shuō yuán lái shōu de shì xìn , bù shì bǎ dēng guān diào . dì èr tiān jiàn miàn , wǒ men yòu bǎ duǎn bǎn dǎ kāi , duì zhe shí jiān zhǎo shǎo diào de nà jǐ miǎo . tā xǐ huān hòu bàn duàn de shēng yīn , wǒ gèng zhù yì jué sè huí tóu de dì fāng , liǎng gè rén gè bǎ zì jǐ xǐ huān de nà yī duàn fàng le yī biàn . zuì hòu tā bǎ gē míng cún hǎo , shuō xià cì zuò chē yě yào tīng , wǒ tí xǐng tā bié xué wǒ bǎ yī jù huà tīng chéng lìng yī jù .
lines.en: I sent a friend the full video and asked for her favourite part. That evening she mentioned the window opening and wondered why I kept talking about the lamp. I sent the two lines I'd missed: so the letters were put away, not the light switched off. Next day we compared the short version and found the missing seconds. She liked the sound in the second half; I noticed the character turning back. We each replayed our favourite section. Saving the song title for her next bus ride, she laughed when I warned her not to mishear it as I had.

questions.q: What changes after watching the full version?
choices: The viewer revises evidence while retaining a qualified personal feeling
The viewer stops allowing different opinions
The performer’s biography becomes certain
questions.answer: The viewer revises evidence while retaining a qualified personal feeling

questions.q: What did the viewer initially mishear?
choices: Putting letters away as turning the light off
Leaving a lamp as buying a train ticket
Opening a window as counting sixty-four visits
questions.answer: Putting letters away as turning the light off

questions.q: Why compare the ending with and without the window?
choices: It reveals how one detail supports an interpretation
It proves all pauses are mistakes
It fixes an author’s private thoughts as known
questions.answer: It reveals how one detail supports an interpretation

lines.en: I read the lyrics without music and caught the line after putting the old letters in a box: it wasn't forgetting the name. On the bus I'd really heard putting away letters as turning off the light. My friend dragged the video back—the lamp stayed on. I still felt the character was reluctant to leave after tidying. She'd noticed the later window opening first. We found both moments and watched them in turn.
